Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the Petitioner through V.C.
2.
Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned A.G.A. for the State.
3. Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for the caveator.

4. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioner to quash the impugned FIR No.0236 of 2025 dated 19.12.2025 punishable under Sections 376, 504 &
506 of IPC, at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun and further to direct the Respondent nos. 1 & 2 not to arrest the Petitioner in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
5. Heard.
6. Admit.
7.
Issue notice to the Respondent no.3, returnable within two weeks.
Steps to be taken within one week.

8. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
9.

10. In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the Petitioner shall not be arrested by the police in connection with the impugned FIR No.0236 of 2025 dated 19.12.2025 punishable under Sections 376, 504 & 506 of IPC, at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun.
However, he will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of his statement.
11. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2025) stands disposed of.
